identityRule: Every budget-accepted ricochet receives runId + tick + accepted tick-local ordinal. Upstream origin.rootId remains in the fold log as sourceRootId, never as its deduplication identity. Budget/no-neighbor rejection does not commit the ordinal. Organ changes do not reset it; a later tick resets only the ordinal. New controller resets the private scalars.
productRule: Each surviving positive basic hit counts toward rankIII period2; current UI says every two hits, not every two shots. Five real rays may therefore legitimately trigger twice. Damage and cadence remain unchanged.
deduplication: runMetrics, acceptedProtocolHit, accepted history, HUD, GrowthTypes, chain frequency and damage formulas unchanged.
targetedCoverage: organ same-tick identity and next-tick reset
independent identical controllers and restart deterministic replay
lethal basic chain and no recursion
limitations: Private receipt ordinals are not a resumable-run persistence schema; existing snapshots are read-only and the game recreates GrowthController on restart.
No main workspace edits or broad simulations by this subtask.
